description: Na₃GdCl₆ is alpha Rhenium trioxide-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NaGdCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaGdCl₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GdCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.70 Å. Gd is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form GdCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Gd-Cl bond lengths are 2.65 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Gd atom.
